summary: Iteration 56 — Ledger v2 (file attachments + AI cockpit). Backend: 27/27 pytest cases PASSED in 84s (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration56_ledger_ai.py, xml at /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration56.xml). Frontend: full end-to-end pass on /ledger with the Sharma demo tenant. All 15 review points VERIFIED end-to-end with REAL AI output — Gemini vision OCR read a generated invoice PNG and returned actual fields; Claude produced a scoped Finance Brief with 5 alerts + 5 recs citing real numbers (₹45,000 outstanding, vendor Rajesh Traders, CNC Lathe ₹336,300); Ask-AI returned data-grounded answers ('Your total outstanding right now is ₹45,000 — a single unpaid invoice for cotton yarn from Rajesh Traders'). Backend coverage details: (1) POST /api/expenses/with-file — no-file path OK, image bill uploaded/stored/served, attachment {filename,url,mime} persisted on the expense, AI extraction runs (falls back to typed on failure; endpoint never 500s); (2) typed values WIN over AI-extracted values (verified: typed title/amount/vendor stayed while AI would have set different vendor from bill); (3) same for /assets/with-file and /inventory/with-file; (4) 400 returned when both typed identifier AND file are empty; (5) an Asset Purchase bill through the new path STILL auto-creates a linked Asset (expense_id linkage intact); (6) GET /api/ledger/ai/{brief,overview,expenses,assets,inventory} all return {scope,summary,alerts[],recommendations[],generated_at}, unknown scope→404; (7) POST /api/ledger/ai/{scope}/refresh returns a NEW generated_at and updates the cache (verified by subsequent GET); (8) POST /api/ledger/ask returns a grounded non-empty answer; empty question→400; (9) RBAC — sales role 403 on every new endpoint (with-file × 3, ai GET, ai refresh, ask); finance role 200 on ai (10) REGRESSION — JSON POST/PATCH/DELETE on expenses/assets/inventory + /api/ledger/summary + /api/expenses/suggest-category all still working. Frontend: /ledger loads with 5 tabs [AI Brief, Overview, Expenses, Assets, Inventory]; **AI Brief is the DEFAULT tab on load** and shows 4 KPI cards (Total Spend, Outstanding, Asset Value, Inventory Value) + AI Finance Brief (summary + 4 Priority Alerts + 5 Recommended Actions) + Ask AI box. Each of the other 4 tabs shows an AI Analysis panel above the existing charts/tables (ai-panel-overview/expenses/assets/inventory). Refresh works (ai-refresh-<scope>), Ask AI returns answers (ai-answer-<scope>). Add Expense dialog opens, ledger-file-input is present, added expense WITHOUT a file, then WITH a small PIL-generated invoice PNG — the row appears in expenses-table WITH a 'Bill' link (view-attachment) that resolves to /api/files/ledger-<uuid>.png. Sharma tenant fully cleaned at end (0 PWFRONT_/TEST_iter56 leftovers in expenses/assets/inventory; 1 stray auto-created asset from the frontend flow was purged in post-cleanup; all ledger-*.png files created by tests were deleted from backend/uploads).

critical_code_review_comments: routers/ledger.py:_read_attachment (line 316-331) — file bytes are loaded fully into memory via `await file.read()` before writing to disk. For a large PDF this doubles memory usage. Consider streaming to disk with `shutil.copyfileobj(file.file, out_f)` in the sync helper. Not blocking for typical bill sizes.

routers/ledger.py:_save_upload_sync (line 100-105) — no MIME/type or size validation. A user could upload a .exe or a 200MB video and it will be silently stored under UPLOAD_DIR and served via GET /api/files/{fname}. Add an `allowed_mime` allowlist (image/*, application/pdf) and a MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES cap; return 415/413 accordingly.

routers/ledger.py:190-195 — auto-created Asset from an 'Asset Purchase' expense STILL hardcodes category='Equipment' even in the new with-file path (flagged in iteration 55). If the AI extracted a real bill category, that context is lost when a linked Asset is created. Consider passing category through, or running a lightweight ASSET_CATEGORIES heuristic on the title/vendor.

routers/ledger.py:add_expense_with_file (line 344) — the empty-check uses `str(data.get('title') or '').strip()` and `_num(data.get('amount'))`; but if a user attaches a bill and AI fails silently (returning {}) AND typed everything is empty, the check will 400. That's correct behavior (fail-fast) but the error message says 'Add a title/amount or attach a readable bill' — which is accurate but could be more helpful by distinguishing 'bill wasn't readable' vs 'no fields typed'. Minor UX polish.

routers/ledger.py:604-628 — POST /api/ledger/ask raises 502 on Claude failure with generic 'AI is busy, please try again'. Consider returning a soft fallback (e.g. echo a summary from _finance_context) so the UI can degrade gracefully instead of a raw error toast. Currently the front-end swallows it into a toast, which is fine but not ideal.

routers/ledger.py:596-602 — POST /api/ledger/ai/{scope}/refresh unconditionally regenerates on every call. If a user spam-clicks Refresh, that's N × ~5-15s Claude calls billed to the tenant. Consider a per-tenant/scope debounce (e.g. reject refresh if the cached generated_at is < 10s ago).

routers/ledger.py:_finance_context (line 516-557) — loads up to 2000 records per collection into memory then reduces in Python. Same scalability concern flagged in iteration 55's ledger_summary — for finance-heavy tenants this becomes O(n) on every AI-panel render. Move totals/by_category/by_vendor/by_month to MongoDB $group pipelines.

Ledger.js:FileField — no client-side file-size or MIME guardrail. `accept='image/*,application/pdf'` is just a hint; a huge or wrong-typed file will still POST. Add a small size check (e.g. reject > 10MB) and toast before upload.

Ledger.js:AiPanel — `staleTime: Infinity` on the /ledger/ai/{scope} query means the panel never refetches on window focus / navigation. That's a deliberate cache choice, but if the user adds an expense from a different tab, the AI panel will still show stale insights until they hit Refresh. Consider invalidating the ledger-ai queryKey inside the same `invalidate()` helper used after CRUD.

Ledger.js:AiPanel — `data.alerts.map((a, i) => ...` uses index as key. If alerts are re-ordered during a refresh, React may reuse the wrong DOM nodes. Prefer `key={a.title + i}` or similar; minor a11y/React polish.

Ledger.js:AttachmentLink — uses `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}${att.url}` — since att.url already starts with '/api/files/...', the concatenation is correct. But if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL includes a trailing slash it becomes '//api/files/…'. Add a small normalizer.
Ledger.js — the runtime a11y warning from iteration 55 ('Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent') was FIXED — all three dialogs now include a <DialogDescription>. Nice cleanup.
Ledger.js — the intentional eslint-disable comment (line 545) on the useMemo dependency array is preserved as instructed.
action_items: OPTIONAL: Add MIME/size validation in _save_upload_sync (currently accepts ANY uploaded file including .exe). Add allowlist for image/* + application/pdf and a max size cap.
OPTIONAL: Stream large uploads to disk instead of loading file bytes into RAM (matters for PDF bills > few MB).
OPTIONAL: Invalidate the ['ledger-ai', scope] React-Query cache alongside the CRUD invalidate() helper so the AI panel updates automatically after adding an expense from a different tab.
OPTIONAL: Debounce or short-cache POST /api/ledger/ai/{scope}/refresh to avoid spam-click AI cost.
OPTIONAL: Auto-created Asset from an Asset Purchase bill still hardcodes category='Equipment' — pass through the AI-extracted category (flagged in iteration 55, still open).
OPTIONAL: Move _finance_context (and ledger_summary) aggregation from Python reduce to MongoDB $group pipelines for finance-heavy tenants.

seed_data_creation: Test suite generated invoice PNGs on the fly with PIL (vendor/amount/date rendered as text), posted them via multipart. All uploaded ledger-*.png files were tracked in CREATED_FILES and deleted from backend/uploads/ at teardown. All PWFRONT_iter56_/TEST_iter56_ rows in expenses/assets/inventory were deleted after run (verified via API GET — 0 residual). One auto-created Asset from the frontend PWFRONT flow (side-effect of 'Asset Purchase' auto-categorization) was found and purged in the post-cleanup pass. Ledger_ai cache docs (per-scope) were NOT deleted — they regenerate whenever a user clicks Refresh and contain real tenant analysis; leaving them intact is by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new feature sets (file attachments + AI cockpit) are fully working. If retesting: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration56_ledger_ai.py -v` — the suite is self-cleaning (CREATED expenses/assets/inventory + CREATED_FILES both cleaned in teardown). For frontend, note that the AI panels can take 15-45s to load Claude output; if you set your Playwright wait_for_selector to 60s you'll be safe. The AI file-extraction path via Gemini vision uses PIL-generated invoices (see _make_invoice_png helper) — these render as plain text on a white canvas which OCRs cleanly. If GEMINI_API_KEY is invalid the endpoint gracefully falls back to Emergent VISION_MODEL — either way it returns 200 with the typed values merged in (never 500s). One code-review NIT: the `attachment` field is intentionally set on the expense doc even when AI extraction fails (so the user can still open the bill from the table row) — that's the correct UX. Same test file pattern (multipart + PIL invoice) can be reused for any future OCR-related tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 27 backend pytest cases and every frontend UI flow passed end-to-end on first run. Findings are code-review polish items (upload MIME/size guardrails, streaming, react-query cache invalidation for ledger-ai after CRUD, hardcoded Equipment category on auto-Asset). Nothing blocks review.
